title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
summary: Meta updated its terms of service to remove language concerning web scraping and AI training practices, though a spokesperson stated this doesn't represent an actual change in Meta's data collection approach. This clarification comes amid ongoing scrutiny of how tech companies use data for AI model training.
content: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

zh.title: Meta删除了引发网络爬虫和AI训练担忧的措辞
zh.summary: Meta更新了其服务条款，删除了涉及网络爬虫和AI训练实践的措辞，尽管发言人声称这并不代表Meta的数据收集方式发生了实际改变。这一澄清是在技术公司如何使用数据进行AI模型训练受到持续审查的背景下提出的。

title: TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
summary: TikTok has permanently banned the advertising account for an upcoming Elon Musk documentary, continuing a pattern of resistance from major social media platforms to the film's promotion. The four-hour documentary by Alex Gibney has faced multiple platform restrictions as its release approaches.
content: A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.

zh.title: TikTok永久封禁"马斯克"纪录片广告账户

title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
summary: Anthropic disclosed that its workforce composition has shifted to include fewer junior employees, with staff spending significantly more time in meetings compared to the previous year. The changes suggest a maturing organization with potentially different organizational dynamics.
content: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

zh.title: Anthropic表示其员工队伍变得更资深，花费更多时间在会议上
zh.summary: Anthropic披露其员工组成发生了变化，初级员工减少，与前一年相比，员工在会议上花费了显著更多的时间。这些变化表明该组织正在成熟，可能具有不同的组织动态。

title: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
summary: TikTok has permanently suspended the social media account for Alex Gibney's Elon Musk documentary ahead of its wider release, continuing a broader pattern of major social media platforms restricting promotion of the film. The platform's distributor was informed the ban would proceed, though TikTok did not immediately comment.
content:
Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk gestures as he speaks during the inaugural parade inside Capitol One Arena, in Washington, DC, on January 20, 2025. (Photo by ANGELA WEISS / AFP) (Photo by ANGELA WEISS/AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images	

Just ahead of the wider release of Alex Gibney's Musk documentary, TikTok has banned the film's social media account from its platform. TikTok did not immediately respond to a request for comment. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the film's distributor, Bleecker Street, was informed Friday afternoon that a "permanent suspension" was imminent. Bleecker Street has not yet responded to a request for comment from The Verge.
While TikTok has no official affiliation with Elon Musk, part owner Larry Ellison appears in the film via a text message offering to help Musk fund his Twitter purchase.
Last month, YouTube, Meta, X, and TikTok all face …

title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
summary: Replit has switched its default AI model provider from Anthropic's Claude to OpenAI, though Claude remains available as an alternative on the platform. The change reflects evolving partnerships in the AI development tools space.
content: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

title: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
summary: Mercedes-AMG unveiled its first entirely in-house developed SUV, the 2028 Mercedes-AMG GT SUV, featuring over 1,150 horsepower and advanced charging capabilities on a dedicated high-performance architecture. The vehicle represents a historic expansion for the performance brand, arriving in the US next summer.
content:
Earlier this year, Mercedes' AMG performance brand grabbed our attention with the GT four-door coupe, a souped-up sports sedan with three axial flux motors delivering over 1,150 horsepower. Well, now meet its beefier cousin, the 2028 Mercedes-AMG GT SUV, an equally powerful, ultra-fast-charging electric people-hauler.
The AMG GT SUV (say that five times fast) marks the first time in the performance brand's 59-year history that it has developed a full-size SUV entirely in-house from the ground up. Scheduled to hit the US next summer, the new EV is built on Merc's high-performance AMG.EA architecture to combine sports-car handling with full-s …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 梅赛德斯-AMG首款自主开发SUV是一头1150马力的电动猛兽
zh.summary: 梅赛德斯-AMG推出了其首款完全内部开发的SUV——2028梅赛德斯-AMG GT SUV，拥有超过1150马力和先进的充电功能，采用专门的高性能架构。该车型代表了这个性能品牌的历史性扩展，将于明年夏天在美国上市。

title: Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
summary: Elon Musk has settled lawsuits from Arizona residents who challenged his $1 million daily voter giveaway program as potentially fraudulent, with settlement terms remaining undisclosed. The sweepstakes had also drawn scrutiny from Philadelphia's District Attorney over whether it constituted an illegal lottery.
content:
In 2024, Elon Musk promised to give away $1 million a day to a randomly selected registered voter in a swing state. That prompted legal challenges, raised questions about its legality, and drew lawsuits from two Arizona residents claiming the lottery was a fraud. Musk has now agreed to settle the two lawsuits filed in Austin, Texas, though the details of the settlement have not been made public.
The plaintiffs claim that when Musk announced the sweepstakes, he falsely claimed the prizes would be awarded randomly. Philadelphia's District Attorney sued to stop the giveaway, claiming that Musk was running an illegal lottery. During a hearing,  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 埃隆·马斯克就百万美元投票者赠送计划诉讼达成和解
zh.summary: 埃隆·马斯克已与质疑其百万美元日常投票者赠送计划为潜在欺诈行为的亚利桑那州居民的诉讼达成和解，和解条款仍未披露。这项抽奖活动也引起了费城地方检察官的审查，他们质疑其是否构成非法彩票。

title: Ember’s new temperature-controlled mug makes my nightly tea ritual even better
summary: Ember has updated its temperature-controlled mug to allow users to adjust drink temperature directly without opening the accompanying app. The enhancement simplifies the user experience for Ember's popular smart beverage container.
content: The biggest change about Ember's new mug is that you no longer have to open the app to adjust your drink’s temperature.

title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
summary: Meta is removing contractual language from its commercial terms that could have allowed it to scrape news sites for AI training, following backlash from publications and legal experts. The removal addresses concerns about Meta training its AI systems on copyrighted news content without permission.
content:
After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page:
… Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, research, train, and maintain the integrity of, the Meta Company Products, services, and features provided under these Commercial Terms and any other applicable supplemental terms.
Many, including Neiman Lab and James Grimmelmann, a professor of digital and information law at Cornell, interpreted it as an  …

title: Pikmin 4 is $20 off ahead of its $10 Nintendo Switch 2 update
summary: Walmart is discounting the digital version of Pikmin 4 for Nintendo Switch to $39.88, down $20 from its usual $59.99 price. Nintendo will release an enhanced Switch 2 version on November 12, 2026, available as a $10 upgrade for existing players.
content:
Pikmin preparing to do battle with a Bulborb | Image: Nintendo	

If you’re wondering what video game to play this weekend, my colleague Sheena Vasani spotted a discounted Nintendo Switch title with instant digital delivery. Walmart has the digital version of Pikmin 4 for Switch discounted to $39.88, just over $20 lower than its usual price. This version of the game follows the same puzzle formula as previous titles in the series, but adds in a dog companion for an extra layer of complexity and action, and dives deeper into the dark undertones previous games hinted at.
Pikmin 4

Where to Buy:

 $59.99 $39.88 at Walmart

Nintendo recently announced a Switch 2 version of Pikmin 4 will launch on November 12th, 2026. That version features polished visuals, adds in voice commands for your dog companion, plus a new mode called Dandori Academy that adds extra challenges over time. You’ll be able to upgrade to that version for just $10, saving you $20 total over buying the $69.99 Switch 2 Edition outright.
Read our Pikmin 4 review.

title: Jad Abumrad loves a butterfly knife and a good springy pillow
summary: Jad Abumrad is profiled for his influential contributions to podcasting, including creating Radiolab and award-winning documentary series about Dolly Parton and Fela Kuti. His experimental approach to sound design and storytelling helped redefine what the podcast medium could achieve in its early days.
content:
It's hard to overstate Jad Abumrad's impact on the podcasting world. He created and hosted Dolly Parton's America and Fela Kuti: Fear No Man, two Peabody Award-winning shows that offered unprecedented looks at the lives of two of the most important music icons of the last century.
Before that, though, he created Radiolab, an experimental NPR show that leaned heavily on creative sound design and eventually helped redefine what a podcast could be. In the early days of podcasting, shows were often just a couple of people talking at each other at a table (some still are), or lazily repackaged radio broadcasts. Radiolab instead told deeply repor …

zh.summary: Jad Abumrad因其对播客的杰出贡献而受到关注，包括创作Radiolab和关于Dolly Parton和Fela Kuti的获奖纪录片系列。他在音效设计和叙事方面的实验性方法帮助重新定义了播客媒体在早期可以实现的目标。

title: SpaceX’s ambitious, expensive gamble to replace AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
summary: SpaceX is making a major push into wireless telecommunications by acquiring low-band spectrum and winning FCC approval for 15,000 next-generation Starlink satellites. The company plans to leverage its satellite network and spectrum holdings to directly compete with major carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile, though industry analysts note significant historical costs and challenges.
content:
Today, I’m talking with Walter Piecyk, a partner and analyst at LightShed Partners who covers tech, media, and telecom, about SpaceX’s recently announced plan to become a major wireless carrier.
Last week, SpaceX agreed to buy a big chunk of low-band spectrum to expand the Starlink network, spectrum that’s been traded around the telecom business for decades now. SpaceX’s ambitious plan is to use that spectrum to help build “the world’s most advanced mobile network.”



Verge subscribers, don’t forget you get exclusive access to ad-free Decoder wherever you get your podcasts. Head here. Not a subscriber? You can sign up here. 
Combined with news that the FCC approved the deployment of 15,000 next-gen Starlink satellites and the company’s previous agreement to purchase close to $20 billion worth of EchoStar spectrum last year, it’s now clear SpaceX is serious about competing with AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile.
I’ve covered the telecom business for a long time, and I’ve always known that these companies can say they want to do something until they run into the harsh reality of how expensive it is to actually do it. The telecom graveyard of pivots, bad ideas, and failed acquisitions is vast.
Walt has been closely monitoring SpaceX’s acquisition, and he’s correctly predicted that the company was headed in this direction for months now. So I wanted to dig into whether SpaceX can pull this off, why Walt thinks the existing telecom giants have really fumbled their response to SpaceX’s growing threat, and what happens when Elon Musk’s rocket company jumps headfirst into a business everyone loves to hate.

title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
summary: Major websites including Yelp and Delta Air Lines are blocking autonomous AI agents from companies like OpenAI, Meta, and xAI from accessing their services and performing tasks like booking reservations or purchasing tickets. The trend signals growing concerns about unauthorized data access and the need for AI agents to respect website policies.
content:
Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your inbox to buying new shoes. But what happens when the rest of the internet won't play nice?
In recent weeks, users of services like Meta's Muse, xAI's Grok, OpenAI's Dots, and Instinct have reported blocks preventing their AI agents from performing tasks across top websites. Yelp told TechCrunch that it only allows AI agents that pay for its data licensing program, while Delta Air Lines is preventing them from booking ticket …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 网站正在关闭对AI代理的大门

title: Bose’s new wired earbuds are simple in the best way
summary: Bose has introduced new wired earbuds as the wired audio category experiences a resurgence among younger consumers who view them as trendy and retro. Wired earbuds offer practical advantages like eliminating battery charging requirements and delivering longer-lasting performance compared to wireless alternatives.
content:
Bose has me thinking I’m in my 20s again with its wired earbuds.	

After Apple courageously removed the headphone jack from the iPhone in 2016, most people switched to Bluetooth earbuds and never looked back. But their wired counterparts have stuck around, and their sales even went up this year after five years of decline.
Part of the resurgence can be tied to the fact that they're cool now with younger generations - following the revival of tape decks and vinyl. Celebrities have been spotted wearing them, and there's even an Instagram account that follows the trend. Wired earbuds have real benefits. They don't need a battery, so they'll last longer than wireless ones that eventually die, and it's a lot ha …

title: Apple’s HomeView is just the latest threat to online recipe writers
summary: Apple's HomeView smart display can extract online recipes and present them in simplified, step-by-step formats, joining a growing list of tools that strip recipes to essential instructions. This trend removes the blog content and advertisements that support recipe writers' business models, threatening the viability of recipe-publishing websites.
content:
The HomeView can simplify online recipe formatting into easy-to-follow steps. | Image: Apple	

When Apple revealed the HomeView to the world, it did so with an unusual ad for the company: Instead of pristine, polished tech in immaculate rooms, it's a three-minute look at the messy, frantic morning routine of a family of five. Apple's new smart display sits in the center of the chaos on the kitchen table, helping the family check their calendars, send messages, and pull up a French toast recipe in seconds, with simple, step-by-step instructions.
The HomeView is just the latest in a long line of websites, browser extensions, and smart home gadgets with the same promise: that it can take an online recipe and strip it down to the essenti …

title: Science says your boss should talk less in meetings
summary: Recent research indicates that managers who listen more and speak less conduct significantly more effective meetings. Eliminating unproductive meetings can further improve workplace communication and efficiency.
content: Research suggests listening more while talking less. Killing aimless meetings can help, too.

zh.summary: 最近的研究表明，倾听更多、说话更少的经理能够进行更有效的会议。消除没有成效的会议可以进一步改进工作场所的沟通和效率。

title: Why BioWare's Neverwinter Nights still has thousands of active players
summary: BioWare's RPG Neverwinter Nights continues to attract thousands of active players despite relatively mediocre single-player content. The game's longevity is driven primarily by community-created content and multiplayer experiences, demonstrating the enduring appeal of player-driven gameplay.
content: The single-player is just OK, but according to the players, that doesn't matter.

title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept

content: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.
